notes: Alpaca has almost no crypto news (4 BTC, 4 ETH and 10 SOL headlines in 90 days, and some are about other companies with the same ticker), and QQQ had 4, so the live news rules never trade here. The price rules need no news: trend is a moving-average crossover, buy-the-dip buys a 3% drop below the recent average; both run on 5-minute bars. Crypto trades pay Alpaca's 0.25% fee each way. The circuit breaker pauses new trades once the account is $30 down and waits for you.
